source: noProxyHosts lists only 127.0.0.1. Since 9.1.0 (NoProxyHostsUtils: an IP-address entry matches only a destination given as that address, no name is looked up) neither a webhook to localhost (afterActions) nor an httpForward to localhost is exempt: both go through forwardHttpProxy (a refusing address: 502)

steps.note: the webhook to localhost goes out after the response
it did not arrive: localhost is not looked up, so the listed 127.0.0.1 does not match it
an explicit httpForward to localhost is not resolved before the check: proxied
